results.title: Delhi Rains: 9 Houses Collapse, 16 Trees Uprooted Amid Incessant Showers; Light Rainfall Likely Today, Tomorrow
results.description: Heavy rainfall battered Delhi, causing severe waterlogging, traffic disruption and structural damage across the city. The Delhi Fire Service said it received reports of nine house collapses and 16 tree falls since Thursday night. Three women trapped after one tree-fall incident were rescued, while rainwater also entered parts of Safdarjung Hospital.
